question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The study of different skin diseases
solution:
The correct answer is **'Dermatology.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let us see the **meanings **of the given options:

 
 
• **Neurology: **the scientific study of nerves and their diseases. (स्‍नायु-विज्ञान)
 
• **Dermatology: **the scientific study of skin diseases. (चर्म-रोग-विज्ञान, त्‍वचा-विज्ञान)
 
• **Psychology: **the scientific study of the mind and the way that people behave. (व्‍यक्तियों के मन और व्‍यवहार की रीति का वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन; मनोविज्ञान)
 
• **Radiology: **the science dealing with X-rays and other high-energy radiation, especially the use of such radiation for the diagnosis and treatment of disease. (एक्स-रे और अन्य उच्च-ऊर्जा विकिरण से संबंधित विज्ञान, विशेष रूप से रोग के निदान और उपचार के लिए ऐसे विकिरण का उपयोग)
 
 
 
• From the meanings of the given words, we can say that the study of different skin diseases is called **"Dermatology."**
 
• Hence, the correct answer is Option 2.
